sentences.text: The name Velafrons means 'sailed forehead,' describing the dinosaur's unique head crest.
This medium-sized herbivore grew to about 7.5 meters long and weighed roughly 2.5 metric tons.
Fossils of this lambeosaurine hadrosaurid were found in Mexico around 73.5 million years ago.
The species Velafrons coahuilensis was named in 2007 based on the holotype specimen CPC-59, marking the first new lambeosaurine genus from North America in over seven decades.
As a hadrosaurid, Velafrons ate plants.
Velafrons is a member of the ornithischian dinosaur class and the hadrosaurid family.
It belongs to the subfamily Corythosaurini.
The genus existed between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
Scientists consider the specimen a subadult, though this conclusion relies on comparisons with other species.
